description: Create or edit a document the model writes for you, shown as a card you can read, edit again, and save.
author: MaiPai

examples: write me a packing list for the camping trip
put this recipe in a document I can save
make a document with these steps
draft a short story for me as a document
write that up as a document
can you turn this into a document

artifact_id.description: The id of the version being edited. Present only when the model is updating a document it already wrote earlier in this conversation.
